name: Kouban
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood police box, Midori Kouban: a police-box tour reservation notice, a first day helping at the police box, a tour booking guide, a trial crime-prevention consultation corner notice, a new-recruit training plan comparison, a column about noticing a familiar resident's change in manner during a safety patrol, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to manage lost items, an explainer on why in-person hearing is still needed in the online-reporting era, a bicycle anti-theft registration service application guide, a column on how an online reporting system changed front-desk response work, a new rule for year-end crime-prevention patrol strengthening, a column on the meaning of a veteran officer's skill for sensing a change at the scene, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elementary school's traffic-safety education program. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
